licenses.text:
μετάφραση των εβδομήκοντα, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/grcbrent/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/grcbrent/copyright.htm):
> The Greek Septuagint with Apocrypha, compiled by Sir Lancelot C. L. Brenton
> Public Domain
> Language: Ἑλληνική (Greek, Ancient)
> Dialect: Koine
> 2026-04-08

Why this is public domain:
Compiler: Sir Lancelot Charles Lee Brenton, 1807-1862, United Kingdom; the Greek text itself is ancient. Text: the Greek of his Septuagint with Apocrypha, London, Samuel Bagster and Sons. US: published before 1931. United Kingdom: life plus 70 years ended in 1932.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grcbrent), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/grcbrent/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lancelot_Charles_Lee_Brenton; https://archive.org/details/septuagintversio00bren; https://archive.org/details/septuagintversio1900bren; https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1988/48/section/12; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.
